chunks: If he makes him swear regarding what he took from him, then it is permissible for him to swear if he says this statement.

key_terms.اِسْتَحْلَفَهُ: he asked him to swear an oath

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible to swear an oath concerning property taken from someone?
ai.summary: This narration gives a legal ruling about taking an oath in a case involving what was taken from another person. It indicates that such an oath is permissible under a specific verbal condition mentioned in the report.
